These bracelets can be worn regularly to imbibe its maximum results. 6 mukhi Rudraksha is ruled by Lord Kartikeya and planet Mars and confers the wearer with stability and qualities of spontaneity, focus, grounding and tolerance. We are the oldest accredited Rudraksha organization the world.
